usage: The word 單車 (daan1 ce1) is a noun used to refer to a bicycle.
You can use 單車 to talk about riding, buying, or fixing a bicycle.
It often appears with verbs like 騎 (ride), 行 (go), or 掉咗單車 (lost the bicycle).
單車 can also be used to describe types of transport in daily conversation.
In questions, 單車 is used straightforwardly, like '你有冇單車？' (Do you have a bicycle?).
